outcome: adverse events (oedema, hyponatraemia, suspected necrotising enterocolitis, pulmonary hypertension)
cohort: The study involved 73 infants diagnosed with transient hyperinsulinism (THI) of less than 6 months duration, who commenced low-dose diazoxide treatment at a median age of 11 days.
finding: Low-dose diazoxide, with doses less than 5 mg/kg/day, proved effective in infants with transient hyperinsulinism, and associated adverse events were generally mild.
followup_time: Median duration of diazoxide treatment was 4 months (range 0.3-6.8 months).
birth_weight: Weight at diazoxide start: 1000-2000 g, 2000-3500 g, >3500 g.
